issues.problem: Context 4 「往生際が悪いようですが」 is an unnatural hedge for self-deprecating use.
issues.action: Rewrote as 「往生際が悪いと思われるかもしれませんが」. Story (Buddhist 往生, moment of death) checked and kept.

issues.problem: Context 3 (「一回褒められたくらいで…なよ」) and context 6 (writer carried away by debut success) fit 調子に乗る (ky071, same set) just as well. Misuse 2's suggested fix 有頂天にさせた is not the natural correction.
issues.action: Replaced both contexts with pure-joy situations (grinning friend; grandfather after first grandchild). Changed misuse 2's why to 彼の言葉で有頂天になった. Story (Buddhist highest heaven) kept.

issues.problem: Context 3 「意表を突かれる質問をされて」 is an awkward double passive. Contexts 1 and 4 (twist ending, silent father bursting into song) fit 度肝を抜く (ky317) as well.
issues.action: Context 3 is now 「思わぬ質問に意表を突かれ」. Context 1 now states the twist explicitly (the narrator was the culprit). Context 4 is now a mild expectation-defying choice (ramen stall instead of the usual restaurant), where 度肝を抜く would be too strong.

issues.problem: Misuse 1's why said the idiom 'only' means losing patience, but dictionaries also list the literal sense (legs going numb from long sitting).
issues.action: Rewrote the why: with 足 as the subject it is wrong. The idiom takes a person as subject and now means running out of patience.

issues.problem: Context 5 「保護したのも乗りかかった船だ」 is an awkward construction.
issues.action: Rewrote as 「迷子の犬を拾ったのは自分だし、乗りかかった船だ。」

issues.problem: Context 2 「これまでの努力を棒に振る」 fits 水の泡 (ky069, same set) equally well (努力を水の泡にする).
issues.action: Changed the object to a recommendation (せっかくもらった推薦を棒に振る), which suits 棒に振る but not 水の泡.

issues.idiom: 助け船を出す / 元の鞘に収まる / 重箱の隅をつつく / 同じ釜の飯を食う
issues.problem: No defects found. Checked: story null (correct), meaning, contexts, misuses, cue, near and furigana. よりを戻す is not in the set, so the lover contexts for 元の鞘に収まる are not ambiguous within the set.
